text: dsh-chat-tree 是面向 DSH 网页和桌面客户端的对话分支树插件：它从宿主会话记录生成分支图，并在聊天区右侧提供可点击导轨。用户可以查看当前会话的父子分支、点击轮次跳转或从某轮继续新分支；也可折叠左侧会话列表、合并或拆分会话树、收藏节点并编辑名称、形状和颜色。插件还呈现压缩、未读及撤回轮次，并提供范围、尺寸和外观设置。适合需要浏览、整理和继续多分支对话的 DSH 用户。无需额外 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-chat-tree displays DSH conversation branches as a clickable tree beside the chat. Jump to a turn or continue from it in a new branch. Fold sessions by tree, merge or split trees, and rename or favorite nodes. It marks compacted, unread, and rewound turns; settings adjust the visible range.
我想把一段对话分出去的多个分支放在一张图里看。
有没有办法点一下就回到之前某一轮继续提问？
让左侧的会话列表按对话树收拢，别让每条分支都占一行。
我想给重要的对话轮次加星标、改名并区分颜色。
怎么把两棵会话树并起来，之后再拆回去？
我希望大树只显示当前轮附近的节点，还能调整节点大小。
Can I see all the branches of a chat as a clickable tree?
I want to jump back to an earlier turn and branch the conversation from there.
How can I fold related sessions into one row in the sidebar?
I need to merge separate conversation trees and split them apart later.
dsh-chat-tree 的功能「分支树导航」：把会话轮次绘成分支图，点击节点跳到该轮，或从该节点继续开启新分支。
dsh-chat-tree 的功能「侧栏折叠」：按对话树将左侧会话列表收成树头一行，点击箭头展开或收起分支。
dsh-chat-tree 的功能「树结构编辑」：在节点详情中合并、拆分或重新接回会话分支，调整对话树的组织方式。
dsh-chat-tree 的功能「节点标注」：在详情卡中重命名节点、收藏节点，并设置收藏图标和颜色；标注保存到 DSH 侧。
dsh-chat-tree 的功能「显示范围设置」：通过设置选择按层数或树上距离筛选可见节点，并调节节点与导轨尺寸。
dsh-chat-tree 的功能「撤回轮次标记」：读取宿主日志及旁车中的撤回信息，在树图中将撤回轮次标记并从后续对话路径区分出来。

dsh-chat-tree README · Introduction：

dsh-chat-tree

Every branch of a conversation, drawn as a tree down the right edge of DeepSeek Harness.
Click a dot to jump to that turn. Click ＋ to continue from it.

dsh-chat-tree README · Introduction：

English · 中文

---

dsh-chat-tree README · Install：**Desktop app** (DeepSeek Harness 0.2): open **Settings → Plugins → Install** and enter
`dsh-chat-tree`. Its settings live under **Settings → Conversation tree**.

**Web / CLI** (dsh 0.1.5):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:JRJRJPRO/dsh-chat-tree
```

Refresh your browser and it's live — no dsh restart, no other plugins needed.

dsh-chat-tree README · Install：To remove it: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-chat-tree`. It also shows up under
**Installed** in the plugin market, where the toggle turns it on and off in about a second.

dsh-chat-tree README · The tree draws itself： Refresh the page and it's already there, next to your chat. Every dot is one turn. **Click one to jump to it** — the turn you're looking at is filled in solid as you scroll. Branches sit side by side, so you can see at a glance where a conversation split and which path you're on. Named nodes carry their label right on the tree.

dsh-chat-tree README · The sidebar folds too：In the session list on the left, a tree takes up one row: branches tuck under
the root, and a chevron at the front of the row unfolds them. While folded, the
row shows how many conversations the tree holds; a blue dot on the chevron means
a branch inside is still running, a green one means it finished while you
weren't looking. Prefer the flat list? Turn off **Fold sidebar by conversation**
in settings.
dsh-chat-tree README · Every node has a card： Hover a dot for a preview. **Double-click the card to expand it** — rename the node, pick a shape, pick a color, or upload an image.

dsh-chat-tree README · Every node has a card：The red ✕ at the far right of the expanded card **deletes** a branch: the node's
session plus every branch hanging under it on the tree is archived into the host's
archive list — a second click confirms, and anything archived can be restored.
Only the first turn of a branch can be deleted: a log can't lose its middle, so to
drop a few turns use rewind on the message row.

An expanded card closes as soon as you click anywhere in the chat.

dsh-chat-tree README · Every node has a card：There is an invisible divider on the left edge of the tree: drag it to give the tree more or
less room (the chat column re-centres in what is left). The same value is the "tree band
width" setting; 0 turns it off.

On touch devices, a tap does what hovering does.

<br clear="right">

dsh-chat-tree README · Every node has a card：| | |
|---|---|
| **＋** | Continue from this turn as a new branch. On the empty root node, starts a fresh conversation in the same tree |
| **☆** | Favorite. The dot becomes a gold star, and you can give it its own icon and color |
| **⇥ / ⇤** | Split a branch off into its own tree, or put it back |
| **⊕ / ⊖** | Merge another conversation from this folder into the tree, or pull it back out |

A greyed-out button means you can't do it right now — hover it and it will say why.

dsh-chat-tree README · The colors mean something：| | |
|---|---|
| Blue outline | This node is part of your current conversation |
| Solid blue | The turn you're looking at |
| Orange triangle | This turn was compacted |
| Green | Another branch finished while you weren't looking. Open it and the node goes back to normal |
| Faded branch | Turns you rewound — no longer pretending to be part of the conversation |

dsh-chat-tree README · Make it yours： **Settings → Plugins → Conversation tree**. **Visible range** keeps big trees readable by drawing only what's near your current turn — by depth or by distance, whichever you prefer. Either one has an "off" setting. Nodes at the edge shrink and fade rather than vanishing, and come back the moment you hover them.

dsh-chat-tree README · Make it yours：**Node size** scales dots, lines and spacing together, 50%–250%.

**Fold sidebar by conversation** switches the session list back to the host's
flat layout, one row per branch, when turned off.

**Colors** are one row per kind of node, color on the left and shape on the
right. Pick with the color wheel, or type a hex value like `#FFD43B` straight
in. What you set is exactly what gets drawn — the same in light and dark.
**Reset** hands a row back to the default.

<br clear="right">

dsh-chat-tree README · Favorite icons：Once a node is starred, its card offers two more rows:

- **12 shapes** — circle, rounded square, square, diamond, triangle, inverted
  triangle, arrow, pentagon, hexagon, cross, four-point star, hourglass
- **A character** — any letter or emoji, drawn inside a rounded outline
- **An image** — png / jpg / webp / svg, any size, scaled for you

dsh-chat-tree README · Favorite icons：Names, favorites, icons and colors are all stored on the dsh side, so they
follow you to another browser or your phone.
- **A color** — 6 presets, a reset swatch, a color picker, or a typed hex value

dsh-chat-tree README · Introduction：

dsh-chat-tree

把一个对话的所有分支画成一棵树，贴在 DeepSeek Harness 聊天区右缘。
点节点跳到那一轮，点 ＋ 从那儿接着问。

English · 中文

---

dsh-chat-tree README · 安装：**桌面版**（DeepSeek Harness 0.2）：打开 **设置 → 插件 → 安装**，填 `dsh-chat-tree`。
设置在 **设置 → 对话树** 里。

**网页版 / 命令行**（dsh 0.1.5）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:JRJRJPRO/dsh-chat-tree
```

刷新浏览器就能用 —— 不用重启 dsh，也不依赖任何其它插件。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-chat-tree`。它也会出现在**插件市场的「已安装」**里，
那儿的开关就是启用 / 停用，约 1 秒生效。
dsh-chat-tree README · 树会自己出现： 刷新页面，树已经在正文右边了。 一个点就是一轮对话，**单击跳到那一轮** —— 滚到哪一轮，哪个点就填实。 分支并排画，一眼看得出对话在哪儿岔开、你现在走在哪条路上。起过名字的节点， 名字直接写在树上。

dsh-chat-tree README · 左边的列表也跟着折：左侧会话列表里，一棵树只占一行：分支收在树头底下，行首的箭头一点摊开。收起时标题右边
写着这棵树一共几条对话；里面有分支在跑，箭头角上亮一个蓝点，跑完了你还没看就是绿点。
不想要的话，设置里关掉「侧栏按对话折叠」就回到原样。

dsh-chat-tree README · 每个节点都有一张卡片： 悬浮到节点上出缩略卡，**双击卡片展开** —— 改名、挑形状、挑颜色、传张图都在这一档。 展开档最右那颗红色的 ✕ 是**删除**：把这个节点起的整条支线（它所在的会话，加上树上挂在它底下的分支） 归档进宿主的归档列表 —— 点第二下才真删，随时能从归档里恢复。只有支线的头一轮能删：日志删不了半截， 中间几轮要去掉，用消息行上的撤回。 展开着的卡片，点聊天区任意处就整张消失。 树左边有一条看不见的分隔线，按住左右拖能给树多留或少留地方（正文栏会在剩下的宽度里居中）； 设置里的「对话树占位宽度」是同一个值，0 就是不留。 手机、平板这类没有悬停的设备上，点一下就是悬浮。
section: 每个节点都有一张卡片

text:
dsh-chat-tree README · 每个节点都有一张卡片：| | |
|---|---|
| **＋** | 从这一轮之后接着问，开一条新支线；在树根的空节点上则是在同一棵树里新开一条对话 |
| **☆** | 收藏。这个点变成金色五角星，还能单独换图标和颜色 |
| **⇥ / ⇤** | 把一条支线拆成独立的树 / 再接回去 |
| **⊕ / ⊖** | 把本目录下别的对话整棵合并进来 / 拆回去 |

灰掉的按钮表示现在做不了，鼠标停上去会写明原因。
section: 每个节点都有一张卡片

text:
dsh-chat-tree README · 颜色是有含义的：| | |
|---|---|
| 蓝色描边 | 这个节点在你当前的对话里 |
| 蓝色填充 | 你正看着这一轮 |
| 橙色倒三角 | 这一轮做过压缩 |
| 绿色 | 别的分支跑完了，你还没去看。点开那条分支就变回普通 |
| 灰掉的支线 | 撤回掉的轮次，不再假装还在对话里 |

dsh-chat-tree README · 调成你喜欢的样子： **设置 → 插件 → 对话树**。 **显示范围**只画离当前这一轮足够近的节点，树再大也看得清。按层数或按步数， 喜欢哪种用哪种，两种都有「不省略」这一档。边界不硬切 —— 最外圈越画越小越淡， 鼠标滑上去就回来。 **节点大小**把点、连线、间距一起缩放，50%–250%。 **侧栏按对话折叠**关掉就回到宿主原样，每条分支各占一行。 **配色**一行一种节点，左边颜色右边形状。取色盘挑，或者直接填 `#FFD43B` 这样的六位色值。 设什么画什么，明暗主题下一样；按「重置」交还默认。

dsh-chat-tree README · 收藏图标：节点收藏之后，卡片上多出两排：

- **12 个形状** —— 圆 / 圆角方 / 方 / 菱形 / 三角 / 倒三角 / 箭头 / 五边形 / 六边形 / 十字 / 四角星 / 沙漏
- **一个字** —— 填一个字或 emoji，画成它外加一个圆角描边框
- **一张图** —— png / jpg / webp / svg 都行，尺寸不限，自动缩好

改名、收藏、图标、颜色都存在 dsh 这边，换浏览器、上手机都还在。
- **颜色** —— 6 个预设 + 一格恢复默认 + 取色盘，或直接填六位色值
